program = '''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bg=max(set(sum(grid,[])),key=sum(grid,[]).count)
    seen=set(); objs=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c]==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            color=grid[r][c]; q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while q:
                a,b=q.pop(); cells.append((a,b))
                for x,y in ((a-1,b),(a+1,b),(a,b-1),(a,b+1)):
                    if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and (x,y) not in seen and grid[x][y]==color:
                        seen.add((x,y)); q.append((x,y))
            rs=[x for x,y in cells]; cs=[y for x,y in cells]
            objs.append(dict(color=color,cells=cells,r0=min(rs),r1=max(rs),c0=min(cs),c1=max(cs)))
    def holes(o):
        hh=o['r1']-o['r0']+1; ww=o['c1']-o['c0']+1
        inside={(r,c) for r in range(o['r0'],o['r1']+1) for c in range(o['c0'],o['c1']+1)}
        empty=inside-set(o['cells']); found=[]; used=set()
        for p in empty:
            if p in used: continue
            q=[p]; used.add(p); comp=[]
            while q:
                a,b=q.pop(); comp.append((a,b))
                for x,y in ((a-1,b),(a+1,b),(a,b-1),(a,b+1)):
                    if (x,y) in empty and (x,y) not in used:
                        used.add((x,y)); q.append((x,y))
            found.append(comp)
        return found
    frame=next(o for o in objs if holes(o))
    r0,r1,c0,c1=frame['r0'],frame['r1'],frame['c0'],frame['c1']
    out=[[frame['color'] if (r,c) in set(frame['cells']) else bg for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    rects=[]
    for o in objs:
        if o is frame: continue
        hh=o['r1']-o['r0']+1; ww=o['c1']-o['c0']+1
        if len(o['cells'])==hh*ww: rects.append(o)
    unused=rects[:]
    for hole in holes(frame):
        hr=[x for x,y in hole]; hc=[y for x,y in hole]
        a,b,d,e=min(hr),max(hr),min(hc),max(hc); hh=b-a+1; ww=e-d+1
        exact=[o for o in unused if o['r1']-o['r0']+1==hh and o['c1']-o['c0']+1==ww]
        if exact:
            o=exact[0]; unused.remove(o)
            for r in range(hh):
                for c in range(ww): out[a-r0+r][d-c0+c]=o['color']
            continue
        candidates=[o for o in unused if o['r1']-o['r0']+1<=hh and o['c1']-o['c0']+1<=ww]
        if not candidates: continue
        # Several pieces in one cavity retain their relative packing direction.
        horizontal=all(o['r1']-o['r0']+1==hh for o in candidates)
        candidates.sort(key=lambda o:(o['c0'] if horizontal else o['r0'],o['r0']))
        n=len(candidates)
        for i,o in enumerate(candidates):
            oh=o['r1']-o['r0']+1; ow=o['c1']-o['c0']+1
            rr=a+(i*(hh-oh)//max(1,n-1) if n>1 else 0)
            cc=d+(i*(ww-ow)//max(1,n-1) if n>1 else 0)
            for r in range(oh):
                for c in range(ow): out[rr-r0+r][cc-c0+c]=o['color']
            unused.remove(o)
    return out
'''
